name: Grok Build
author: Community Leader (via OMP)
description: Third-party Grok-Build add-on authored through the SDK: proposes chat completions to a local Grok-compatible (OpenAI) service through a simulated loopback.

tools.name: grok_build.status
tools.description: Read the local Grok-compatible runtime health and availability.

tools.name: grok_build.run_task
tools.description: Run a delegated prompt through the local Grok-compatible runtime and propose the completion (prepare/propose — a human approves the commit).
